title: CompletionsRunEnd

reason.description: Why a run ended: completed, error, interrupted (with its cause), disposed (the environment let the run go: its session was deleted, or the environment closed), drained (cut by a drain's cap).

anyOf.description: What interrupted a run: user (runs.interrupt), read-now, restart (the recovery sweep after a restart), parked (its process was stopped while parked on a prompt), timeout (a routine's firing ran past its maximum duration).

description: How the run ended: its run.ended reason and, for an interrupted one, the cause.
